verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since E2B is a cloud sandbox service with an SDK, CLI and API surface for which a published OpenAPI spec would be plausible. The pack shows no downloadable spec: probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on docs.e2b.dev all returned 404. The available llms.txt and markdown docs are documentation indexes, not a machine-readable API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
